scope: Successful query/selector/source-routing facts only. No actor answers, content grades, usage or elapsed costs. Assess relevance separately; selecting coordinates does not establish acquired native content or semantic sufficiency.

question.question: A maintenance team changes shared parser library L, producing subject S1 on basis B1. Old checks A, B and C all passed on S0/B0. For A, supported analysis covers its assertion, execution and reliance dependencies and establishes an applicable preservation relation to S1/B1; those dependencies are unaffected. B executes L. For C, the dependency view has no path from L, but its material dependency coverage is incomplete. A mandatory deployment gate G applies independently of change-based selection. Two agreeing suites were written by different model families but use the same implementation-derived expected-output generator and the same old input observations. A manager multiplies their nominal miss rates 0.1 x 0.1 and calls the result a 99% probability that the Product is correct. Give an applied decision on reusing A/B/C, skipping G, and that assurance claim. Then assess the bounded claim "the required assurance for this change is complete" under three separate followups: P, B and C produce valid current passing evidence, G passes, A's applicability is established, and every fixed required obligation and material join has valid support; F, B produces an admissible counterexample to a required predicate while C has no current return; U, there is no counterexample, B and G pass, and the only current information about C is a dispatch receipt with no return. State supported conclusions, refusal or uncertainty, what remains to be acquired or decided, and the limit of any acceptance claim. Cite exact source law; treat the stated hypothetical facts as facts.
